name: BUB1 mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine kinase B

function.text: BUB1B encodes mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine-protein kinase BUB1 beta. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, centromeric and mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling.
